purpose: Teach: つぶやく/励む/どうのこうの/苦笑い/こぞって/余程/あたらしい/どことなく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、何かをつぶやくように召し上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I noticed a customer earlier—they were eating kind of quietly, like they had something on their mind.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if remembering a small moment. Soft attack. Warm but measured. Speaking more to herself than reporting. Slight hesitation before the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、私達もお店の改善に励むしかないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We'll just have to keep working on ways to make the cafe better, I guess.
lines.style: Quiet resolve, not resentment. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. A small exhale on 'just have to.' Speaking as if to herself, accepting rather than fighting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がどうのこうのと味の感想を仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was commenting on the taste, you know—had opinions about everything.
lines.style: Wry, slightly amused observation. Light and knowing, like she's seen this before. No edge, just recognition. Eyebrow lift in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、おすすめを聞いて苦笑いしてらしたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And when I asked about their recommendation, they gave that awkward laugh, like they didn't quite know what to say.
lines.style: Dry humor, a small smile underneath. Even pacing, noticing the customer's discomfort without judgment. Sharing the observation like a small, private joke.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がこぞって新メニューを選ばれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But all the customers went straight for the new menu items—everyone chose them.
lines.style: Slight brightening, like a small win. Warm and pleased but understated. Letting the good news land softly. No exclamation, just satisfaction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、余程気に入って下さったみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items seem to have really landed with people. They genuinely liked them.
lines.style: Calm approval. A nod in the voice. Speaking with the quiet satisfaction of seeing something work. Warm but composed, like acknowledging something that was worth the effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店内にあたらしい鉢植えを置きましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe we should put some new plants around the cafe—freshen things up a bit.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, gentle direction. Picturing it as she speaks. Hopeful but not pushing. Offering an idea that feels natural, like she's just thought of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、どことなく寂しそうにお茶を飲まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer came in for tea earlier and just sat there looking sort of... lonely, somehow.
lines.style: Quiet, lingering sadness. Soft attack on the opening. Slow, searching for the right word. Trailing off on 'somehow,' like the feeling is hard to name. Deep noticing.
